newsitem.title: TUNISIA: French defence minister ends visit to Tunisia.
newsitem.headline: French defence minister ends visit to Tunisia.

text.p: French Defence Minister Charles Millon on Tuesday ended his 48-hour visit to Tunisia where he conferred with President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on security issues in the Mediterranean, a Western diplomat said.
During his visit, Millon presided with his Tunisian counterparts over the 5th joint French-Tunisian military commission, the diplomat said but gave no details.
The French minister was quoted by local press after he met earlier President Ben Ali as saying: "Tunisia and France have a great role to establish peace and security in the Mediterranean."
Millon also announced a visit of the Tunisian leader to France in the coming weeks. He gave no date.
